classification_rule: experience_memory.classify_relation: aggregate >= +0.005 and min(per-series) >= -0.005 -> POSITIVE; aggregate >= +0.005 with any per-series < -0.005 -> CONFLICT

sampling.note: three arms x three replica orders replay the same origins, so run records are not independent samples; every statistic below is computed on the unique units

harmed_series_stability.reading: the harmed set is not stable across units, so a Scope revision keyed on series identity has no stable subset to exclude

identity_smase_association.why: identity sMASE at this origin is a downstream Consumer outcome, not a pre-deployment observable a held-out Fast Path may read; it is reported only to show the harm is systematic rather than random, and the deployment-visible feature audit is a separate step that has not been run yet
